Class SignatureClient<C extends SignatureCredentials, P extends SignatureProfile, T extends Signature>

org.pac4j.core.ext.client.SignatureClient<C,P,T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.pac4j.core.client.Client
public abstract class SignatureClient<C extends SignatureCredentials, P extends SignatureProfile, T extends Signature> extends org.pac4j.core.client.DirectClient
Direct client for signature-based authentication. Extracts signatures from request parameters and validates the signed payload.
